about.title: About Us
about.description: We innovate and collaborate to bring quality natural products to our community.

purpose.title: Purpose
items: maximizing the profits obtained by agri-food producers compared to current revenues from selling unprocessed products;

raising the professional level through the implementation of advanced bioresource processing technologies, as well as developing creative and entrepreneurial skills for launching new competitive products aimed at domestic and international markets;
broadening the socio-economic knowledge base as a foundation for the sustainable development of individual households;
concrete exemplification and encouragement of expanding the categories of bioresources that can generate income through innovative processing;
encouraging the acquisition of new equipment needed for processing local bioresources;
adoption of project results by specialists through technology transfer.

mainObjective.title: Main Objective
mainObjective.text: obtaining new innovative traditional assortments from plant bioresources by adding bioactive compounds and natural flavorings, alongside developing professional skills and increasing socio-economic benefits for small farmers, ensuring sustainable development for this category of agricultural producers.

secondaryObjectives.title: Secondary Objectives
items: Documenting the inventory of local plant bioresources, followed by processing this information with a logistic software to be developed from research and laboratory analysis of the inventoried bioresources.

Obtaining high value-added dairy products and preparations by adding concentrated extracts of bioactive compounds and natural flavorings that prevent degradation over time and provide hedonic taste and smell characteristics.
Superior capitalization of by-products from primary processing through complementary conditioning operations, resulting in both bases for functional feed and natural fertilizers.
